ko.executive_summary: Galaxy S27 Ultra flagship likely to retain Snapdragon processors despite Exynos 2700 rumors claiming up to 20% performance gains. MediaTek's Dimensity 9600 Pro powers vivo X500 Series.
key_facts: Galaxy S27 Ultra may use global Snapdragon processor
Exynos 2700 reportedly up to 20% more powerful than alternative
vivo X500 Series powered by MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro

implications.text: Samsung prioritizing global Snapdragon availability over in-house Exynos for premium flagships despite performance improvements in later generations.
Continued tier-1 device adoption of Dimensity 9600 Pro signals confidence in MediaTek's premium-segment competitiveness against Qualcomm.

ko.counterpoint: Exynos 2700 performance claims remain unverified; actual Galaxy S27 Ultra chipset allocation still speculative.
